verses.original: Ὁ Δὲ Σαῦλος ἔτι ἐμπνέων ἀπειλῆς καὶ φόνου εἰς τοὺς μαθητὰς τοῦ Κυρίου προσελθὼν τῷ ἀρχιερεῖ
verses.transliteration: HO De Saulos eti empneōn apeilēs kai phonou eis tous mathētas tou Kyriou proselthōn tō archierei
verses.literal: Meanwhile Saul was still breathing out murderous threats against the disciples of the Lord He approached the high priest
verses.literalPt: E SAULO, respirando ainda ameaças e mortes contra os discípulos do SENHOR, dirigiu-se ao sumo sacerdote.

verses.original: ᾐτήσατο παρ’ αὐτοῦ ἐπιστολὰς εἰς Δαμασκὸν πρὸς τὰς συναγωγάς ὅπως ἐάν τινας εὕρῃ τῆς Ὁδοῦ ὄντας ἄνδρας τε καὶ γυναῖκας δεδεμένους ἀγάγῃ εἰς Ἰερουσαλήμ
verses.transliteration: ētēsato par’ autou epistolas eis Damaskon pros tas synagōgas hopōs ean tinas heurē tēs Hodou ontas andras te kai gynaikas dedemenous agagē eis Ierousalēm
verses.literal: and requested . . . . . . letters to the synagogues in Damascus so that if he found any men or women belonging to the Way he could bring them as prisoners . . . to Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: E pediu-lhe cartas para Damasco, para as sinagogas, a fim de que, se encontrasse alguns daquela seita, quer homens quer mulheres, os conduzisse presos a Jerusalém.

verses.original: Ἐν δὲ τῷ πορεύεσθαι ἐγένετο αὐτὸν ἐγγίζειν τῇ Δαμασκῷ ἐξαίφνης τε αὐτὸν περιήστραψεν φῶς ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ
verses.transliteration: En de tō poreuesthai egeneto auton engizein tē Damaskō exaiphnēs te auton periēstrapsen phōs ek tou ouranou
verses.literal: As Saul drew near to Damascus on his journey suddenly a light from heaven flashed around him
verses.literalPt: E, indo no caminho, aconteceu que, chegando perto de Damasco, subitamente o cercou um resplendor de luz do céu.

verses.original: καὶ πεσὼν ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν ἤκουσεν φωνὴν λέγουσαν αὐτῷ Σαοὺλ Σαούλ τί με διώκεις
verses.transliteration: kai pesōn epi tēn gēn ēkousen phōnēn legousan autō Saoul Saoul ti me diōkeis
verses.literal: He fell to the ground and heard a voice say to him Saul Saul why do you persecute Me
verses.literalPt: E, caindo em terra, ouviu uma voz que lhe dizia: Saulo, Saulo, por que me persegues?

verses.original: Εἶπεν δέ Τίς εἶ Κύριε Ὁ δέ Ἐγώ εἰμι Ἰησοῦς ὃν σὺ διώκεις
verses.transliteration: Eipen de Tis ei Kyrie Ho de Egō eimi Iēsous hon sy diōkeis
verses.literal: Who are You Lord Saul asked I am Jesus whom you are persecuting He replied
verses.literalPt: E ele disse: Quem és, Senhor? E disse o Senhor: Eu sou Jesus, a quem tu persegues. Duro é para ti recalcitrar contra os aguilhões.

verses.original: ἀλλὰ ἀνάστηθι καὶ εἴσελθε εἰς τὴν πόλιν καὶ λαληθήσεταί σοι ὅ τί σε δεῖ ποιεῖν
verses.transliteration: alla anastēthi kai eiselthe eis tēn polin kai lalēthēsetai soi ho ti se dei poiein
verses.literal: Now get up and go into . . . the city and you will be told . . . what you must do
verses.literalPt: E ele, tremendo e atônito, disse: Senhor, que queres que eu faça? E disse-lhe o Senhor: Levanta-te, e entra na cidade, e lá te será dito o que te convém fazer.

verses.original: Οἱ δὲ ἄνδρες οἱ συνοδεύοντες αὐτῷ εἱστήκεισαν ἐνεοί ἀκούοντες μὲν τῆς φωνῆς μηδένα δὲ θεωροῦντες
verses.transliteration: Hoi de andres hoi synodeuontes autō heistēkeisan eneoi akouontes men tēs phōnēs mēdena de theōrountes
verses.literal: The men traveling with Saul stood there speechless They heard the voice but did not see anyone
verses.literalPt: E os homens, que iam com ele, pararam espantados, ouvindo a voz, mas não vendo ninguém.

verses.original: ἠγέρθη δὲ Σαῦλος ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς ἀνεῳγμένων δὲ τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν αὐτοῦ οὐδὲν ἔβλεπεν χειραγωγοῦντες δὲ αὐτὸν εἰσήγαγον εἰς Δαμασκόν
verses.transliteration: ēgerthē de Saulos apo tēs gēs aneōgmenōn de tōn ophthalmōn autou ouden eblepen cheiragōgountes de auton eisēgagon eis Damaskon
verses.literal: Saul got up from the ground but when he opened his eyes he could not see a thing So they led him by the hand . . . . . . into Damascus
verses.literalPt: E Saulo levantou-se da terra, e, abrindo os olhos, não via a ninguém. E, guiando-o pela mão, o conduziram a Damasco.

verses.original: καὶ ἦν ἡμέρας τρεῖς μὴ βλέπων καὶ οὐκ ἔφαγεν οὐδὲ ἔπιεν
verses.transliteration: kai ēn hēmeras treis mē blepōn kai ouk ephagen oude epien
verses.literal: For three days he was without sight and he did not eat or drink anything
verses.literalPt: E esteve três dias sem ver, e não comeu nem bebeu.

verses.original: Ἦν δέ τις μαθητὴς ἐν Δαμασκῷ ὀνόματι Ἁνανίας καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτὸν ἐν ὁράματι ὁ Κύριος Ἁνανία Ὁ δὲ εἶπεν Ἰδοὺ ἐγώ Κύριε
verses.transliteration: Ēn de tis mathētēs en Damaskō onomati Hananias kai eipen pros auton en horamati ho Kyrios Hanania Ho de eipen Idou egō Kyrie
verses.literal: In Damascus there was a disciple named Ananias The Lord spoke to him in a vision Ananias Here I am Lord - he answered
verses.literalPt: E havia em Damasco um certo discípulo chamado Ananias; e disse-lhe o Senhor em visão: Ananias! E ele respondeu: Eis-me aqui, Senhor.

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ Κύριος πρὸς αὐτόν Ἀναστὰς πορεύθητι ἐπὶ τὴν ῥύμην τὴν καλουμένην Εὐθεῖαν καὶ ζήτησον ἐν οἰκίᾳ Ἰούδα Σαῦλον ὀνόματι Ταρσέα ἰδοὺ γὰρ προσεύχεται
verses.transliteration: Ho de Kyrios pros auton Anastas poreuthēti epi tēn rhymēn tēn kaloumenēn Eutheian kai zētēson en oikia Iouda Saulon onomati Tarsea idou gar proseuchetai
verses.literal: Get up the Lord told him Go to the house of Judas on - Straight Street and ask for a man from Tarsus named Saul for he is praying
verses.literalPt: E disse-lhe o Senhor: Levantate, e vai à rua chamada Direita, e pergunta em casa de Judas por um homem de Tarso chamado Saulo; pois eis que ele está orando;

verses.original: καὶ εἶδεν ἄνδρα ἐν ὁράματι Ἁνανίαν ὀνόματι εἰσελθόντα καὶ ἐπιθέντα αὐτῷ τὰς χεῖρας ὅπως ἀναβλέψῃ
verses.transliteration: kai eiden andra en horamati Hananian onomati eiselthonta kai epithenta autō tas cheiras hopōs anablepsē
verses.literal: In a vision he has seen a man named Ananias come and place his hands on him to restore his sight
verses.literalPt: E numa visão ele viu que entrava um homem chamado Ananias, e punha sobre ele a mão, para que tornasse a ver.

verses.original: Ἀπεκρίθη δὲ Ἁνανίας Κύριε ἤκουσα ἀπὸ πολλῶν περὶ τοῦ ἀνδρὸς τούτου ὅσα κακὰ τοῖς ἁγίοις σου ἐποίησεν ἐν Ἰερουσαλήμ
verses.transliteration: Apekrithē de Hananias Kyrie ēkousa apo pollōn peri tou andros toutou hosa kaka tois hagiois sou epoiēsen en Ierousalēm
verses.literal: But Ananias answered Lord many people have told me about this man and all the harm he has done to Your saints in Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: E respondeu Ananias: Senhor, a muitos ouvi acerca deste homem, quantos males tem feito aos teus santos em Jerusalém;

verses.original: καὶ ὧδε ἔχει ἐξουσίαν παρὰ τῶν ἀρχιερέων δῆσαι πάντας τοὺς ἐπικαλουμένους τὸ ὄνομά σου
verses.transliteration: kai hōde echei exousian para tōn archiereōn dēsai pantas tous epikaloumenous to onoma sou
verses.literal: And now he is here with authority from the chief priests to arrest all who call on Your name
verses.literalPt: E aqui tem poder dos principais dos sacerdotes para prender a todos os que invocam o teu nome.

verses.original: Εἶπεν δὲ πρὸς αὐτὸν ὁ Κύριος Πορεύου ὅτι σκεῦος ἐκλογῆς ἐστίν μοι οὗτος τοῦ βαστάσαι τὸ ὄνομά μου ἐνώπιον τῶν ἐθνῶν τε καὶ βασιλέων υἱῶν τε Ἰσραήλ
verses.transliteration: Eipen de pros auton ho Kyrios Poreuou hoti skeuos eklogēs estin moi houtos tou bastasai to onoma mou enōpion tōn ethnōn te kai basileōn huiōn te Israēl
verses.literal: Go said the Lord - This man is My chosen instrument to carry My name before the Gentiles and their . . . kings and before the people of Israel
verses.literalPt: Disse-lhe, porém, o Senhor: Vai, porque este é para mim um vaso escolhido, para levar o meu nome diante dos gentios, e dos reis e dos filhos de Israel.

verses.original: ἐγὼ γὰρ ὑποδείξω αὐτῷ ὅσα δεῖ αὐτὸν ὑπὲρ τοῦ ὀνόματός μου παθεῖν
verses.transliteration: egō gar hypodeixō autō hosa dei auton hyper tou onomatos mou pathein
verses.literal: I will show him how much he must suffer for My name
verses.literalPt: E eu lhe mostrarei quanto deve padecer pelo meu nome.

verses.original: Ἀπῆλθεν δὲ Ἁνανίας καὶ εἰσῆλθεν εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν καὶ ἐπιθεὶς ἐπ’ αὐτὸν τὰς χεῖρας εἶπεν Σαοὺλ ἀδελφέ ὁ Κύριος ἀπέσταλκέν με Ἰησοῦς ὁ ὀφθείς σοι ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ ᾗ ἤρχου ὅπως ἀναβλέψῃς καὶ πλησθῇς Πνεύματος Ἁγίου
verses.transliteration: Apēlthen de Hananias kai eisēlthen eis tēn oikian kai epitheis ep’ auton tas cheiras eipen Saoul adelphe ho Kyrios apestalken me Iēsous ho ophtheis soi en tē hodō hē ērchou hopōs anablepsēs kai plēsthēs Pneumatos Hagiou
verses.literal: So Ananias went to the house and when he arrived . . . he placed his hands on Saul Brother Saul he said the Lord Jesus who appeared to you on the road as you were coming here has sent me so that you may see again and be filled with the Holy Spirit
verses.literalPt: E Ananias foi, e entrou na casa e, impondo-lhe as mãos, disse: Irmão Saulo, o SENHOR Jesus, que te apareceu no caminho por onde vinhas, me enviou, para que tornes a ver e sejas cheio do Espírito Santo.

verses.original: Καὶ εὐθέως ἀπέπεσαν αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν ὡς λεπίδες ἀνέβλεψέν τε καὶ ἀναστὰς ἐβαπτίσθη
verses.transliteration: Kai eutheōs apepesan autou apo tōn ophthalmōn hōs lepides aneblepsen te kai anastas ebaptisthē
verses.literal: At that instant something like scales fell from Saul’s eyes and his sight was restored He got up and was baptized
verses.literalPt: E logo lhe caíram dos olhos como que umas escamas, e recuperou a vista; e, levantando-se, foi batizado.

verses.original: καὶ λαβὼν τροφὴν ἐνίσχυσεν Ἐγένετο δὲ μετὰ τῶν ἐν Δαμασκῷ μαθητῶν ἡμέρας τινὰς
verses.transliteration: kai labōn trophēn enischysen Egeneto de meta tōn en Damaskō mathētōn hēmeras tinas
verses.literal: and after taking some food he regained his strength And he spent several days with the disciples in Damascus
verses.literalPt: E, tendo comido, ficou confortado. E esteve Saulo alguns dias com os discípulos que estavam em Damasco.

verses.original: Καὶ εὐθέως ἐν ταῖς συναγωγαῖς ἐκήρυσσεν τὸν Ἰησοῦν ὅτι οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: Kai eutheōs en tais synagōgais ekēryssen ton Iēsoun hoti houtos estin ho Huios tou Theou
verses.literal: Saul promptly began to proclaim Jesus in the synagogues declaring He is the Son of God
verses.literalPt: E logo nas sinagogas pregava a Cristo, que este é o Filho de Deus.

verses.original: Ἐξίσταντο δὲ πάντες οἱ ἀκούοντες καὶ ἔλεγον Οὐχ οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ πορθήσας εἰς Ἰερουσαλὴμ τοὺς ἐπικαλουμένους τὸ ὄνομα τοῦτο καὶ ὧδε εἰς τοῦτο ἐληλύθει ἵνα δεδεμένους αὐτοὺς ἀγάγῃ ἐπὶ τοὺς ἀρχιερεῖς
verses.transliteration: Existanto de pantes hoi akouontes kai elegon Ouch houtos estin ho porthēsas eis Ierousalēm tous epikaloumenous to onoma touto kai hōde eis touto elēlythei hina dedemenous autous agagē epi tous archiereis
verses.literal: All who heard him were astounded and asked Isn’t . . . this the man who wreaked havoc in Jerusalem on those who call on this name And hasn’t he come here - to take them as prisoners to the chief priests
verses.literalPt: E todos os que o ouviam estavam atônitos, e diziam: Não é este o que em Jerusalém perseguia os que invocavam este nome, e para isso veio aqui, para os levar presos aos principais dos sacerdotes?

verses.original: Σαῦλος δὲ μᾶλλον ἐνεδυναμοῦτο καὶ συνέχυννεν τοὺς Ἰουδαίους τοὺς κατοικοῦντας ἐν Δαμασκῷ συμβιβάζων ὅτι οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ Χριστός
verses.transliteration: Saulos de mallon enedynamouto kai synechynnen tous Ioudaious tous katoikountas en Damaskō symbibazōn hoti houtos estin ho Christos
verses.literal: But Saul was empowered all the more and he confounded the Jews living in Damascus by proving that Jesus is the Christ
verses.literalPt: Saulo, porém, se esforçava muito mais, e confundia os judeus que habitavam em Damasco, provando que aquele era o Cristo.

verses.original: Ὡς δὲ ἐπληροῦντο ἡμέραι ἱκαναί συνεβουλεύσαντο οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι ἀνελεῖν αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: Hōs de eplērounto hēmerai hikanai synebouleusanto hoi Ioudaioi anelein auton
verses.literal: After many days had passed the Jews conspired to kill him
verses.literalPt: E, tendo passado muitos dias, os judeus tomaram conselho entre si para o matar.

verses.original: ἐγνώσθη δὲ τῷ Σαύλῳ ἡ ἐπιβουλὴ αὐτῶν παρετηροῦντο δὲ καὶ τὰς πύλας ἡμέρας τε καὶ νυκτὸς ὅπως αὐτὸν ἀνέλωσιν
verses.transliteration: egnōsthē de tō Saulō hē epiboulē autōn paretērounto de kai tas pylas hēmeras te kai nyktos hopōs auton anelōsin
verses.literal: but Saul learned of their plot - Day and night they watched the city gates in order to kill him
verses.literalPt: Mas as suas ciladas vieram ao conhecimento de Saulo; e como eles guardavam as portas, tanto de dia como de noite, para poderem tirar-lhe a vida,

verses.original: λαβόντες δὲ οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ νυκτὸς διὰ τοῦ τείχους καθῆκαν αὐτὸν χαλάσαντες ἐν σπυρίδι
verses.transliteration: labontes de hoi mathētai autou nyktos dia tou teichous kathēkan auton chalasantes en spyridi
verses.literal: One night however his disciples took him and lowered him in a basket - through a window in the wall
verses.literalPt: Tomando-o de noite os discípulos o desceram, dentro de um cesto, pelo muro.

verses.original: Παραγενόμενος δὲ εἰς Ἰερουσαλὴμ ἐπείραζεν κολλᾶσθαι τοῖς μαθηταῖς καὶ πάντες ἐφοβοῦντο αὐτόν μὴ πιστεύοντες ὅτι ἐστὶν μαθητής
verses.transliteration: Paragenomenos de eis Ierousalēm epeirazen kollasthai tois mathētais kai pantes ephobounto auton mē pisteuontes hoti estin mathētēs
verses.literal: When Saul arrived in Jerusalem he tried to join the disciples but they were all afraid of him not believing that he was a disciple
verses.literalPt: E, quando Saulo chegou a Jerusalém, procurava ajuntar-se aos discípulos, mas todos o temiam, não crendo que fosse discípulo.

verses.original: Βαρνάβας δὲ ἐπιλαβόμενος αὐτὸν ἤγαγεν πρὸς τοὺς ἀποστόλους καὶ διηγήσατο αὐτοῖς πῶς ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ εἶδεν τὸν Κύριον καὶ ὅτι ἐλάλησεν αὐτῷ καὶ πῶς ἐν Δαμασκῷ ἐπαρρησιάσατο ἐν τῷ ὀνόματι τοῦ Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: Barnabas de epilabomenos auton ēgagen pros tous apostolous kai diēgēsato autois pōs en tē hodō eiden ton Kyrion kai hoti elalēsen autō kai pōs en Damaskō eparrēsiasato en tō onomati tou Iēsou
verses.literal: Then Barnabas brought him to the apostles and described . . . how Saul had seen the Lord who had spoken to him on the road to Damascus and how Saul had spoken boldly in that city in the name of Jesus
verses.literalPt: Então Barnabé, tomando-o consigo, o trouxe aos apóstolos, e lhes contou como no caminho ele vira ao Senhor e lhe falara, e como em Damasco falara ousadamente no nome de Jesus.

verses.original: Καὶ ἦν μετ’ αὐτῶν εἰσπορευόμενος καὶ ἐκπορευόμενος εἰς Ἰερουσαλήμ παρρησιαζόμενος ἐν τῷ ὀνόματι τοῦ Κυρίου
verses.transliteration: Kai ēn met’ autōn eisporeuomenos kai ekporeuomenos eis Ierousalēm parrēsiazomenos en tō onomati tou Kyriou
verses.literal: So Saul stayed with them moving about freely . . . . . . in Jerusalem and speaking boldly in the name of the Lord
verses.literalPt: E andava com eles em Jerusalém, entrando e saindo,

verses.original: ἐλάλει τε καὶ συνεζήτει πρὸς τοὺς Ἑλληνιστάς οἱ δὲ ἐπεχείρουν ἀνελεῖν αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: elalei te kai synezētei pros tous Hellēnistas hoi de epecheiroun anelein auton
verses.literal: He talked and debated with the Grecian Jews but they tried to kill him
verses.literalPt: E falava ousadamente no nome do Senhor Jesus. Falava e disputava também contra os gregos, mas eles procuravam matá-lo.

verses.original: ἐπιγνόντες δὲ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ κατήγαγον αὐτὸν εἰς Καισάρειαν καὶ ἐξαπέστειλαν αὐτὸν εἰς Ταρσόν
verses.transliteration: epignontes de hoi adelphoi katēgagon auton eis Kaisareian kai exapesteilan auton eis Tarson
verses.literal: When the brothers learned of this they took him down . . . to Caesarea and sent him off . . . to Tarsus
verses.literalPt: Sabendo-o, porém, os irmãos, o acompanharam até Cesaréia, e o enviaram a Tarso.

verses.original: Ἡ μὲν οὖν ἐκκλησία καθ’ ὅλης τῆς Ἰουδαίας καὶ Γαλιλαίας καὶ Σαμαρείας εἶχεν εἰρήνην οἰκοδομουμένη καὶ πορευομένη τῷ φόβῳ τοῦ Κυρίου καὶ τῇ παρακλήσει τοῦ Ἁγίου Πνεύματος ἐπληθύνετο
verses.transliteration: Hē men oun ekklēsia kath’ holēs tēs Ioudaias kai Galilaias kai Samareias eichen eirēnēn oikodomoumenē kai poreuomenē tō phobō tou Kyriou kai tē paraklēsei tou Hagiou Pneumatos eplēthyneto
verses.literal: Then the church throughout . . . Judea Galilee and Samaria experienced a time of peace It grew in strength and numbers living in the fear of the Lord and the encouragement of the Holy Spirit
verses.literalPt: Assim, pois, as igrejas em toda a Judéia, e Galiléia e Samaria tinham paz, e eram edificadas; e se multiplicavam, andando no temor do Senhor e consolação do Espírito Santo.

verses.original: Ἐγένετο δὲ Πέτρον διερχόμενον διὰ πάντων κατελθεῖν καὶ πρὸς τοὺς ἁγίους τοὺς κατοικοῦντας Λύδδα
verses.transliteration: Egeneto de Petron dierchomenon dia pantōn katelthein kai pros tous hagious tous katoikountas Lydda
verses.literal: As Peter traveled throughout the area he went to visit . . . the saints in Lydda
verses.literalPt: E aconteceu que, passando Pedro por toda a parte, veio também aos santos que habitavam em Lida.

verses.original: εὗρεν δὲ ἐκεῖ ἄνθρωπόν τινα ὀνόματι Αἰνέαν ἐξ ἐτῶν ὀκτὼ κατακείμενον ἐπὶ κραβάττου ὃς ἦν παραλελυμένος
verses.transliteration: heuren de ekei anthrōpon tina onomati Ainean ex etōn oktō katakeimenon epi krabattou hos ēn paralelymenos
verses.literal: There he found a man named Aeneas who had been paralyzed and bedridden . . . . . . for eight years
verses.literalPt: E achou ali certo homem, chamado Enéias, jazendo numa cama havia oito anos, o qual era paralítico.

verses.original: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ ὁ Πέτρος Αἰνέα ἰᾶταί σε Ἰησοῦς Χριστός ἀνάστηθι καὶ στρῶσον σεαυτῷ καὶ εὐθέως ἀνέστη
verses.transliteration: kai eipen autō ho Petros Ainea iatai se Iēsous Christos anastēthi kai strōson seautō kai eutheōs anestē
verses.literal: Aeneas - Peter said to him Jesus Christ heals you Get up and put away your mat . . . Immediately Aeneas got up
verses.literalPt: E disse-lhe Pedro: Enéias, Jesus Cristo te dá saúde; levanta-te e faze a tua cama. E logo se levantou.

verses.original: καὶ εἶδαν αὐτὸν πάντες οἱ κατοικοῦντες Λύδδα καὶ τὸν Σαρῶνα οἵτινες ἐπέστρεψαν ἐπὶ τὸν Κύριον
verses.transliteration: kai eidan auton pantes hoi katoikountes Lydda kai ton Sarōna hoitines epestrepsan epi ton Kyrion
verses.literal: and all who lived in Lydda and Sharon saw him and turned to the Lord
verses.literalPt: E viram-no todos os que habitavam em Lida e Sarona, os quais se converteram ao Senhor.

verses.original: Ἐν Ἰόππῃ δέ τις ἦν μαθήτρια ὀνόματι Ταβιθά ἣ διερμηνευομένη λέγεται Δορκάς αὕτη ἦν πλήρης ἔργων ἀγαθῶν καὶ ἐλεημοσυνῶν ὧν ἐποίει
verses.transliteration: En Ioppē de tis ēn mathētria onomati Tabitha hē diermēneuomenē legetai Dorkas hautē ēn plērēs ergōn agathōn kai eleēmosynōn hōn epoiei
verses.literal: In Joppa there was a disciple named Tabitha (which is translated as Dorcas who was always occupied with works of kindness and charity
verses.literalPt: E havia em Jope uma discípula chamada Tabita, que traduzido se diz Dorcas. Esta estava cheia de boas obras e esmolas que fazia.

verses.original: ἐγένετο δὲ ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις ἐκείναις ἀσθενήσασαν αὐτὴν ἀποθανεῖν λούσαντες δὲ ἔθηκαν αὐτὴν ἐν ὑπερῴῳ
verses.transliteration: egeneto de en tais hēmerais ekeinais asthenēsasan autēn apothanein lousantes de ethēkan autēn en hyperōō
verses.literal: At that time however she became sick and died and her body was washed . . . and placed in an upper room
verses.literalPt: E aconteceu naqueles dias que, enfermando ela, morreu; e, tendo-a lavado, a depositaram num quarto alto.

verses.original: ἐγγὺς δὲ οὔσης Λύδδας τῇ Ἰόππῃ οἱ μαθηταὶ ἀκούσαντες ὅτι Πέτρος ἐστὶν ἐν αὐτῇ ἀπέστειλαν δύο ἄνδρας πρὸς αὐτὸν παρακαλοῦντες Μὴ ὀκνήσῃς διελθεῖν ἕως ἡμῶν
verses.transliteration: engys de ousēs Lyddas tē Ioppē hoi mathētai akousantes hoti Petros estin en autē apesteilan dyo andras pros auton parakalountes Mē oknēsēs dielthein heōs hēmōn
verses.literal: Since Lydda was near Joppa the disciples hearing that Peter was there sent two men to urge him Come to us without delay
verses.literalPt: E, como Lida era perto de Jope, ouvindo os discípulos que Pedro estava ali, lhe mandaram dois homens, rogando-lhe que não se demorasse em vir ter com eles.

verses.original: Ἀναστὰς δὲ Πέτρος συνῆλθεν αὐτοῖς ὃν παραγενόμενον ἀνήγαγον εἰς τὸ ὑπερῷον καὶ παρέστησαν αὐτῷ πᾶσαι αἱ χῆραι κλαίουσαι καὶ ἐπιδεικνύμεναι χιτῶνας καὶ ἱμάτια ὅσα ἐποίει μετ’ αὐτῶν οὖσα ἡ Δορκάς
verses.transliteration: Anastas de Petros synēlthen autois hon paragenomenon anēgagon eis to hyperōon kai parestēsan autō pasai hai chērai klaiousai kai epideiknymenai chitōnas kai himatia hosa epoiei met’ autōn ousa hē Dorkas
verses.literal: So Peter got up and went with them On his arrival they took him to the upper room All the widows stood around him weeping and showing him the tunics and other clothing that Dorcas had made while she was still with them
verses.literalPt: E, levantando-se Pedro, foi com eles; e quando chegou o levaram ao quarto alto, e todas as viúvas o rodearam, chorando e mostrando as túnicas e roupas que Dorcas fizera quando estava com elas.

verses.original: Ἐκβαλὼν δὲ ἔξω πάντας ὁ Πέτρος καὶ θεὶς τὰ γόνατα προσηύξατο καὶ ἐπιστρέψας πρὸς τὸ σῶμα εἶπεν Ταβιθά ἀνάστηθι ἡ δὲ ἤνοιξεν τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς αὐτῆς καὶ ἰδοῦσα τὸν Πέτρον ἀνεκάθισεν
verses.transliteration: Ekbalōn de exō pantas ho Petros kai theis ta gonata prosēuxato kai epistrepsas pros to sōma eipen Tabitha anastēthi hē de ēnoixen tous ophthalmous autēs kai idousa ton Petron anekathisen
verses.literal: Then Peter sent them all out of the room He knelt down . . . . . . and prayed and turning toward her body he said Tabitha get up - She opened her eyes and seeing Peter she sat up
verses.literalPt: Mas Pedro, fazendo sair a todos, pôs-se de joelhos e orou: e, voltando-se para o corpo, disse: Tabita, levanta-te. E ela abriu os olhos, e, vendo a Pedro, assentou-se.

verses.original: δοὺς δὲ αὐτῇ χεῖρα ἀνέστησεν αὐτήν φωνήσας δὲ τοὺς ἁγίους καὶ τὰς χήρας παρέστησεν αὐτὴν ζῶσαν
verses.transliteration: dous de autē cheira anestēsen autēn phōnēsas de tous hagious kai tas chēras parestēsen autēn zōsan
verses.literal: Peter took her by the hand and helped her up . . . Then he called the saints and widows and presented her to them alive
verses.literalPt: E ele, dando-lhe a mão, a levantou e, chamando os santos e as viúvas, apresentou-lha viva.

verses.original: Γνωστὸν δὲ ἐγένετο καθ’ ὅλης τῆς Ἰόππης καὶ ἐπίστευσαν πολλοὶ ἐπὶ τὸν Κύριον
verses.transliteration: Gnōston de egeneto kath’ holēs tēs Ioppēs kai episteusan polloi epi ton Kyrion
verses.literal: This became known all over Joppa and many people believed in the Lord
verses.literalPt: E foi isto notório por toda a Jope, e muitos creram no Senhor.

verses.original: Ἐγένετο δὲ ἡμέρας ἱκανὰς μεῖναι ἐν Ἰόππῃ παρά τινι Σίμωνι βυρσεῖ
verses.transliteration: Egeneto de hēmeras hikanas meinai en Ioppē para tini Simōni byrsei
verses.literal: And . . . Peter stayed for several days in Joppa with a tanner named Simon
verses.literalPt: E ficou muitos dias em Jope, com um certo Simão curtidor.
